subject.title: When calling a VLLM model, the usage page statistics show no data. How can I calculate usage and cost when using VLLM?

question: For this vLLM Usage-page report, should maintainers keep collecting evidence first, route any cost-only gap to the unknown-pricing contract, or change provider/runtime defaults now?
rationale: Current source has the intended vLLM token-usage path, while the report lacks artifacts that distinguish token capture failure from missing local pricing or UI aggregation behavior.

options.title: Require current evidence first
options.body: Keep this issue open for raw vLLM stream, transcript, Usage API, screenshot, and pricing-config evidence before approving a new code change.

options.title: Route cost-only behavior to pricing contract
options.body: If the reporter can show token counts are present but cost is blank or zero, handle the remaining work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674.

options.title: Change runtime/provider defaults now
options.body: Approve a broader default or warning for vLLM/custom OpenAI-compatible usage and pricing without waiting for a current-main reproduction.

recommendation.title: Require current evidence first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for raw vLLM stream, transcript, Usage API, screenshot, and pricing-config evidence before approving a new code change.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent related provider-compat discussion and commits make this the best available routing owner for the compatibility/product decision.
